# GEO report: harbor-site

**New to GEO?** GEO (generative engine optimization) means making your site easy for search engines and AI tools to find, read and quote. This report checks the technical basics.

## Code score: 69/100, Unconfirmed → Needs work

Confidence: High (checked 25 of 25 points).
How it's calculated: low = 17.33 ÷ 25 × 100 = 69. High = (17.33 + 0) ÷ 25 × 100 = 69.

Every rule could be settled from the code, so the score is a single number. The main losses are two AI search crawlers blocked in `robots.txt`, broken structured data (JSON-LD, the machine-readable data block), a canonical (the page's preferred address) hardcoded to the home page, and a snippet restriction applied by default. No blocker cap applied. There's no `geo.config.json`, so I assumed you want to be found by search and AI tools.

## Live check

- **Not run.** To add it, give me your site's URL.

## Do these first

### 1. Let OAI-SearchBot and PerplexityBot crawl the site
- **Why it matters:** these are the crawlers behind ChatGPT search and Perplexity. Blocking them site-wide means those tools can't read any page.
- **Where:** `public/robots.txt:4-8`
- **What the code says:** `User-agent: OAI-SearchBot` / `Disallow: /` and `User-agent: PerplexityBot` / `Disallow: /`
- **Size:** Small (delete two groups). If the block is deliberate, ignore this item.
- **Score after this:** 81

### 2. Fix the two broken JSON-LD blocks
- **Why it matters:** the FAQ block has a misspelled key, so its answers can't be read. The Article block has a trailing comma, so it isn't valid JSON and can't be parsed at all.
- **Where:** `src/data/faq.json:8` and `src/pages/moorings.astro:9`
- **What the code says:** `" ": {` (it should be `"acceptedAnswer"`) and `"headline": "Moorings and prices", }`
- **Size:** Small
- **Score after this:** 77

### 3. Give each page its own canonical
- **Why it matters:** every page tells search engines its preferred address is the home page, so `/moorings` and `/contact` point to the wrong URL.
- **Where:** `src/layouts/Base.astro:8`
- **What the code says:** `<link rel="canonical" href="https://harbor.example/" />`
- **Size:** Small (build it from the page path)
- **Score after this:** 75

## All results

| Rule | What it checks | Code | Where |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| GEO-013 | robots.txt is valid | Clear | `public/robots.txt`, valid lines |
| GEO-009 | Search crawlers can access the site | Problem | `public/robots.txt:5,8`, site-wide, 0 of 3 routes |
| GEO-014 | Routes are indexable | Clear | `/contact` is noindex on purpose (`contact.astro:4`), so it isn't flagged. The other 2 routes are indexable |
| GEO-015 | Absolute canonical on own URL | Problem | `Base.astro:8`, 1 of 3 routes clear |
| GEO-003 | Content is in server HTML | Clear | Astro static pages, 3 of 3 routes |
| GEO-004 | JSON-LD is valid | Problem | `faq.json:8`, `moorings.astro:9`, 0 of 2 routes |
| GEO-011 | Sitemap is discoverable | Clear | `public/sitemap.xml`, `robots.txt:10` |
| GEO-012 | Title, description, lang | Clear | `Base.astro:4-7`, 3 of 3 routes |
| GEO-016 | Key routes reachable by links | Clear | `Base.astro:12` |
| GEO-017 | No snippet restriction conflicts | Problem | `Base.astro:9`, 1 of 3 routes clear (`/contact` overrides it) |
| GEO-002 | Accessibility basics | Clear | Read `Newsletter.jsx` (labelled input, text button) and `Base.astro`. No images in the code |
| GEO-101 | Mobile app files | Not applicable | No app declared |
| GEO-010 | llms.txt (info only) | Not applicable | None present, and it isn't scored |
| GEO-102 | App structured data (info only) | Not applicable | Not an app |

## Other problems found

- **Noindex page listed in the sitemap:** `public/sitemap.xml:5`: `<url><loc>https://harbor.example/contact</loc></url>`, while `src/pages/contact.astro:4` sets `robots="noindex"`. Remove it from the sitemap, or drop the noindex if you do want the page found.
- **Default snippet block:** `src/layouts/Base.astro:9`: `robots ?? "max-snippet:0"`. This is the default for any page that doesn't pass `robots`. It tells search and AI tools to show no text excerpt from `/` and `/moorings`. It's scored under GEO-017, and the fix is to change the default to `"index, follow"`.

## Worth considering

- **FAQ answers exist only in a script:** `src/pages/index.astro:8`: `set:html={JSON.stringify(faq)}`. Visitors never see "by the night" or "May to September". Once the JSON-LD is fixed, also show these questions and answers as visible text on the page.
- **Prices page promises more than it shows:** `src/pages/moorings.astro:5`: `description="Mooring sizes and seasonal prices."`, but the page body is only `Prices start at £40 a night.` Add a table of mooring sizes and seasonal prices.
- **Site name and location aren't machine-readable:** `src/layouts/Base.astro` has no Organization or LocalBusiness data. Add one with the harbour's name, Falmouth address and phone `01326 000000`, taken from the contact page.
- **Head basics are missing:** `src/layouts/Base.astro:5-10` has no `charset`, `viewport` or social tags (`og:title`, `og:description`). Add them, and wrap the page content in `<main>`.
- **Hand-kept canonical and sitemap:** `package.json` has no `astro.config` with a `site` value, and `sitemap.xml` is a static file. Set `site: "https://harbor.example"` and use `@astrojs/sitemap`, which builds both from the real routes and can add `<lastmod>`.
- **Home page has no links to related pages:** `src/pages/index.astro:6-7` mentions moorings and a water taxi, but the only way onward is the nav. Link `Seasonal and visitor moorings` to `/moorings`.
- **Title and description don't say where:** `src/pages/moorings.astro:5`: `title="Moorings and prices"`. Add "Falmouth" and the harbour's name so the title says whose prices these are.

## Can't tell from code

- **Bot protection:** code can't show whether a CDN or firewall lets real crawlers through. Run `geopilot logs <access log>`, which checks real crawlers against their published addresses.
- **Live-only checks:** real status codes, redirects and `X-Robots-Tag` headers, and whether the sitemap URLs answer 200. A live scan with your URL would settle these.

## Assumptions

- You want search and AI tools to find the site (there's no `geo.config.json`).
- The domain `harbor.example` is a placeholder for the real one.
- The `/contact` noindex is deliberate.

## What to do next

1. Run the geopilot `fix` command to apply item 1. You'll see every change before anything is written.
2. Run the geopilot `explain` command with any rule id, such as `GEO-014`, to learn more.
3. For proof from a running site, ask for a live scan with its URL.

Technical readiness only. GEO does not measure or predict citations, rankings, traffic or inclusion in any AI or search product.
